body: Recalling the same action on msys works...

From https://www.gnu.org/software/findutils/manual/html_node/find_html/Error-Messages-From-xargs.html:

> 
> ‘environment is too large for exec’
> This message means that you have so many environment variables set (or such large values for them) that there is no room within the system-imposed limits on program command line argument length to invoke any program. This is an unlikely situation and is more likely result of an attempt to test the limits of xargs, or break it. Please try unsetting some environment variables, or exiting the current shell. You can also use ‘xargs --show-limits’ to understand the relevant sizes.
I don't think those `| xargs echo` are even needed (used to replace all whitespace characters by simple space), since the git notes return only one word.
Sent out a change to remove those xargs echo, trying to figure out a way to fix 0.5.3 release now.
So the generated binaries does not have the version label either.
(normal because it is set from the command before). So let's try to simply patch on the fly in the pipeline itself.
Ok re-running the release pipeline without sending mail.
So the re-run worked the new release is on release.bazel.build. I deleted the release on github and will do yet another run that should publish good artifacts everywhere :)
http://ci.bazel.io/blue/organizations/jenkins/Global%2Fpipeline/detail/pipeline/162/pipeline <-- the pipeline is running, now in less than 30 minute we should get a clean release

The release is done now correctly, the fix is published as fc6c3cb, so I am closing this bug.
